record.confidence_note: The sale page was read on 2026-11-06 and its prices are quoted. The cart is still unreadable: the deploy route answers 200 with 2,006 bytes and no price string, so the price at checkout is unverified rather than confirmed. The weakest field is the cart, which keeps the record unverified.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'BLACK FRIDAY SPECIAL 1GB RAM ... 20GB NVMe ... 3TB @ 1Gbit/s ... $12/year [ORDER NOW]'; '2.5GB RAM ... 40GB NVMe ... 4TB ... $22/year $38/2 years | $50/3 years'; the page reads 'LIMITED TIME OFFER - BLACK FRIDAY 2025'
HTTP 200, 2,006 bytes, sha256 ffc79d5dcba383e5... - a Next.js shell with an empty #__next div and no price in the bytes
control: HTTP 200, 2,006 bytes, sha256 ffc79d5dcba383e5... - byte-identical to the real plan code, which proves the route does not encode a product and the 200 is not evidence of an offer
redirects to /black-friday-2025, so the short path is the same page
the 1 GB tier is still USD 12 a year on the live sale page
the 1 GB tier still carries 3 TB a month at 1 Gbit/s
the sale page still lists the accepted payment methods, a card among them
evidence.quote: Credit Card, PayPal, AliPay, and Crypto Accepted

evidence.proved: the deploy route answers 200 with 2,006 bytes and no price string, the same answer the record's 2026-10-24 probe got, so the cart still cannot be read without an account
the cart still returns no price, which is the caveat the verdict rests on

record.notes: The sale page is live, dated 2025 and priced, and the order links are real console routes, but the console is a client-rendered app: the deploy URL returns the same 2,006 bytes for a valid plan code and a made-up one, so nothing about price or stock can be read without signing in. That control is the reason this row is unverified rather than a finding - without it the HTTP 200 would have looked like a working cart. Does not create accounts. The verdict is qualifies-with-caveat rather than dead because the page and its prices are first-party and current; it is not qualifies because nothing confirms the cart still charges them.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 12 a year divided by 12 is USD 1.00 a month, paid once. The 2.5 GB tier is USD 22 a year, USD 1.8333 a month; its two-year price of USD 38 is USD 1.5833 a month.
